# Steel Mind Engineers Pvt. Ltd.

> Steel Mind Engineers designs, fabricates and erects pre-engineered buildings, industrial sheds, steel warehouses and custom steel structures across Pakistan. Factory and head office are in Lahore.

Phone: +92 300 4253966, +92 307 7077549. Email: info@steelmind.pk.
Head Office: 35-D Commercial, DHA EME Sector, Lahore. Factory: Karol Ghati, Lahore, Punjab 54000.

## Main Divisions
- [Pre-Engineered Buildings (PEB)](https://www.steelmind.pk/pre-engineered-buildings-pakistan/): A pre-engineered building (PEB) is a steel building whose parts are designed in advance and made in a factory. Steel Mind Engineers designs, fabricates and erects PEBs in Pakistan under one contract.
- [Industrial Sheds](https://www.steelmind.pk/industrial-sheds-pakistan/): An industrial shed is a large steel building that gives covered space for production, storage, animals or machines. Steel Mind Engineers designs the shed, makes the steel in Lahore and erects it on your site anywhere in Pakistan.
- [Steel Warehouses](https://www.steelmind.pk/steel-warehouses-pakistan/): A steel warehouse gives you open floor area for racks, pallets and trucks. Steel Mind Engineers designs it for your goods and handling method, makes the steel in Lahore and erects it on your site in Pakistan.
- [Structural Steel Fabrication](https://www.steelmind.pk/structural-steel-fabrication-pakistan/): Structural steel fabrication is the making of load-carrying steel parts from plates and sections. The parts are cut, drilled, welded and painted in a workshop, then bolted or welded together on site. Steel Mind Engineers fabricates to your drawings or to drawings prepared by its own engineers.
- [Custom Steel Fabrication](https://www.steelmind.pk/custom-steel-fabrication-pakistan/): Custom steel fabrication means making a steel item to your own design and size. Steel Mind Engineers Pvt. Ltd. fabricates machine frames, tanks, hoppers, doors, gates and stairs from your drawing or sketch.

## Services
- [Overview](https://www.steelmind.pk/services/): Steel Mind Engineers Pvt. Ltd. provides seven services in one chain: design, detailing, fabrication, cleaning, painting, erection and after sale service. You can buy the whole chain or any single step.
- [Design](https://www.steelmind.pk/services/design/): Design is the first service in a steel project. Steel Mind Engineers engineers set the loads, choose the frame and size every member, then show you a 3D model for approval before any steel is cut.
- [Detailing](https://www.steelmind.pk/services/detailing/): Detailing turns an approved design into drawings for every steel part. Steel Mind Engineers prepares fabrication drawings, cutting lists and erection drawings so that parts are made right and fit on site the first time.
- [Fabrication](https://www.steelmind.pk/services/fabrication/): Fabrication is the stage where steel plates and sections become finished parts. Steel Mind Engineers Pvt. Ltd. cuts, drills, fits and welds each part in its own factory, inspects it and packs it in erection order.
- [Cleaning](https://www.steelmind.pk/services/cleaning/): Cleaning is the step between fabrication and painting. Steel Mind Engineers removes mill scale, rust, oil, grease and weld spatter so that the coating bonds to bare steel and lasts longer.
- [Painting](https://www.steelmind.pk/services/painting/): Painting protects steel from rust. Steel Mind Engineers applies a primer and, where the project needs it, further coats chosen for the building's use and weather. Parts leave the factory with the agreed coating.
- [Erection](https://www.steelmind.pk/services/erection/): Erection is the assembly of the fabricated steel on your site. Steel Mind Engineers crews work from the same drawings the factory used, follow a written lifting plan, bolt the structure to specification and fit the sheeting and accessories.
- [After Sale Services](https://www.steelmind.pk/services/after-sale-services/): A steel building needs care for decades. Steel Mind Engineers Pvt. Ltd. stays available after handover for repairs, repainting, added bays, new accessories and questions about the structure.

## Projects
- [PEB Crane and Mezzanine Shed (Haier)](https://www.steelmind.pk/projects/haier-peb-crane-and-mezzanine-shed-raiwind/): Steel Mind Engineers Pvt. Ltd. built a pre-engineered crane and mezzanine shed for Haier at Raiwind, Lahore. The shed is 33 feet high, 182 feet wide and 532 feet long and covers 97,888 square feet. It is the largest project Steel Mind Engineers has built.
- [PEB Dairy Shed (Dravton Dairy)](https://www.steelmind.pk/projects/dravton-dairy-peb-dairy-shed-chunian/): Steel Mind Engineers Pvt. Ltd. built a pre-engineered dairy shed for Dravton Dairy at Chunian. The shed is 17 feet high, 115 feet wide and 342 feet long and covers 39,330 square feet. It is the largest dairy shed Steel Mind Engineers has built.
- [PEB Milking Parlour Shed (Dravton Dairy)](https://www.steelmind.pk/projects/dravton-dairy-peb-milking-parlour-shed-chunian/): Steel Mind Engineers Pvt. Ltd. built a pre-engineered milking parlour shed for Dravton Dairy at Chunian. The shed is 17 feet high and covers 21,686 square feet.
- [PEB Mezzanine Floor (Maria B)](https://www.steelmind.pk/projects/maria-b-peb-mezzanine-floor-lahore/): Steel Mind Engineers Pvt. Ltd. built a pre-engineered mezzanine floor for Maria B in Lahore. The floor is 12 feet high, 90 feet wide and 78 feet long and covers 7,020 square feet.
- [Dairy Rapid Exit Structure (Dravton Dairy)](https://www.steelmind.pk/projects/dravton-dairy-rapid-exit-structure-chunian/): Steel Mind Engineers Pvt. Ltd. built a dairy rapid exit structure for Dravton Dairy at Chunian. The structure is 7 feet high, 22 feet wide and 22 feet long and covers 484 square feet.
- [Water Requirement Bridge (M/S Yascon)](https://www.steelmind.pk/projects/yascon-water-requirement-bridge-petaro/): Steel Mind Engineers Pvt. Ltd. fabricated and erected a steel water requirement bridge for M/S Yascon at Petaro Cantt, Sindh. The bridge is 150 feet long, 6 feet wide and 30 feet high, with an area of 900 square feet.

## About

## Blog
- [What Is a Pre-Engineered Building? A Plain Guide for Pakistani Business Owners](https://www.steelmind.pk/blog/what-is-a-pre-engineered-building/): A pre-engineered building, or PEB, is a steel building whose frames, purlins and sheets are designed in advance and made in a factory to exact sizes. The parts are then bolted together on your site. This is why a PEB is usually finished sooner than a concrete building of the same size.
- [PEB vs Concrete Construction in Pakistan: Time, Cost and Flexibility Compared](https://www.steelmind.pk/blog/peb-vs-concrete-construction-pakistan/): For wide, open buildings such as factories, warehouses and farm sheds, a PEB is usually faster to build than a concrete building and easier to extend. Concrete is the better choice when the building needs heavy walls for fire or security. The right answer depends on your use, size and site.
- [How Long Does It Take to Build a PEB in Pakistan? The Stages and the Schedule](https://www.steelmind.pk/blog/how-long-to-build-peb-pakistan/): PEB construction time in Pakistan depends on the size of the building, the speed of design approval, the foundation and the site. A PEB is usually ready sooner than a concrete building because fabrication and foundation work run at the same time. The engineer gives a written schedule with the quote.
- [The Data an Engineer Needs Before Quoting Your Steel Building in Pakistan](https://www.steelmind.pk/blog/data-needed-to-quote-steel-building/): To quote a steel building, an engineer needs the use, width, length, eave height, roof slope, bay spacing, loads, site location, openings and any crane or mezzanine. A rough sketch with these numbers is enough to start, and the engineer will ask for the rest.
- [How to Plan a Dairy Shed for Pakistan's Heat: Roof, Ridge and Airflow](https://www.steelmind.pk/blog/dairy-shed-design-pakistan-heat/): A good dairy shed in Pakistan gives shade, lets hot air leave and keeps the floor dry. Plan a high roof, an open ridge, open or louvered sides, an insulated roof where needed and a floor that drains. Steel Mind Engineers has built dairy sheds of 39,330, 22,000 and 21,686 square feet for Dravton Dairy and Latifia Dairy.
- [Poultry Shed Roofs in Pakistan: Why Insulated Panels Help Your Birds and Your Costs](https://www.steelmind.pk/blog/poultry-shed-roof-insulated-panels/): An insulated poultry shed keeps the inside cooler in summer and warmer in winter, so the ventilation system has less work to do. Insulated roof panels, planned fan openings and a frame that carries hanging equipment are the three things to design first. Steel Mind Engineers designs long, narrow steel houses for this use.
- [Factory Shed Checklist for Pakistan: Ten Questions to Answer Before You Build](https://www.steelmind.pk/blog/factory-shed-checklist-pakistan/): Before you order a steel factory shed, answer ten questions: what the plant does, which machines it holds, how wide and long it must be, how high, whether a crane is needed, what the floor must carry, how light and air will enter, where trucks will go, what services hang from the roof and how you will extend it later.
- [Crane Shed Basics in Pakistan: Capacity, Span and Runway Beams Explained](https://www.steelmind.pk/blog/crane-shed-basics-pakistan/): A crane shed is a steel building designed around its overhead cranes. The crane capacity, span, lifting height and working frequency set the size of the columns, the runway beams and the foundation. Steel Mind Engineers built crane sheds of 96,600 and 97,888 square feet for Haier at Raiwind.
- [How to Choose Warehouse Height for Your Racking in Pakistan](https://www.steelmind.pk/blog/warehouse-height-for-racking-pakistan/): Set the eave height of a warehouse from the top of your tallest rack, plus clearance for lights, sprinklers and handling equipment. Then check the clear span for aisles and the floor for point loads. Give the engineer your racking plan before the first drawing, because height is hard to change once the steel is made.
- [Loading Dock Design in Pakistan: Dock Height, Canopy and Yard Depth](https://www.steelmind.pk/blog/loading-dock-design-pakistan/): A good loading dock lets a truck back in, load quickly and leave. Set the dock height from your truck fleet, add a steel canopy for rain and sun, choose the number of doors from the trucks you load at the same time, and leave enough yard depth for turning. Design the frame spacing to match the dock doors.
- [Cold Storage Buildings in Pakistan: What the Steel Frame Must Do](https://www.steelmind.pk/blog/cold-storage-steel-frame-pakistan/): A cold store keeps goods at a set temperature, so the building must stop heat from entering. The steel frame carries the insulated roof and wall panels, the refrigeration equipment and the doors. Plan sealed joints, a tight envelope and the equipment loads from the first drawing, and coordinate with your cooling specialist.
- [Storing Wheat in a Steel Warehouse in Pakistan: Keep It Dry and Ventilated](https://www.steelmind.pk/blog/wheat-storage-steel-warehouse-pakistan/): Wheat must stay dry and cool. A steel grain warehouse needs a leak-free roof, a sealed and raised floor, steady ventilation and walls designed for the sideways push of the stored grain. A good coating protects the steel from grain dust and moisture.
